drivers: Middle East attacks on Saudi refineries and Brent near $110
Price down 16% in 3 months despite October rally
outlooks.summary: Gulf refinery attacks and high crude are bullish, but the supply-pressure score is weak (+0.12) and the latest price is down 16% over 3 months. Newest news points to softer anode cost support, so the net view is balanced.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch whether Saudi refinery and Hormuz disruptions persist and whether petcoke holds above US$100.
outlooks.summary_zh: 海湾炼厂遭袭和高油价偏利多,但供应压力得分偏低(+0.12),且最新价格三个月下跌16%。最新消息显示阳极成本支撑减弱,整体判断为中性。
drivers_zh: 中东袭击沙特炼厂,布伦特油价接近110美元
尽管10月反弹,价格三个月仍下跌16%
阳极成本支撑减弱(SMM,11月13日)
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注沙特炼厂和霍尔木兹海峡的扰动是否持续,以及石油焦能否站稳100美元上方。

drivers: Fed hawkish shift and CPI surprise driving prices down
outlooks.summary: There are no supply-side headlines; price moves are driven by macro factors such as rate-hike bets and a strong dollar. Central bank buying is demand support, not a supply shortage.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch the next US inflation data and Fed signals, plus any mine disruption news.
outlooks.summary_zh: 没有供应端新闻,价格主要受加息预期和美元走强等宏观因素驱动。央行购金属于需求支撑,并非供应短缺。
drivers_zh: 美联储转鹰和CPI超预期压低金价
央行购金依然强劲
无供应短缺相关新闻
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注下一次美国通胀数据和美联储信号,以及任何矿山中断消息。

drivers: DRC export quotas; Glencore output down 52%
outlooks.summary: DRC quotas are cutting output sharply and a Chinese miner has suspended DRC operations, which supports further tightness. Price is down 24% in 3 months, so some relief is priced in, and China's extended export-control pause limits upside.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch DRC quota adjustments and quarterly export volumes.
outlooks.summary_zh: 刚果(金)配额大幅压低产量,一家中资矿企暂停在当地运营,供应偏紧。价格三个月下跌24%,部分缓解已计入价格,而中国延长出口管制暂停期限则限制了上行空间。
drivers_zh: 刚果(金)出口配额,嘉能可产量下降52%
中资矿企暂停刚果(金)业务
中国延长出口管制暂停至2027年(利空)
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注刚果(金)配额调整及季度出口量。

drivers: Copper-moly major slows molybdenum output growth
Record-low TCs and war-hit supply chains
outlooks.summary: Slower output growth from a major producer and tight concentrate markets point to further tightness. Price is already up 18% in 3 months and 42% in 12 months, so part of this is priced in, though the news still leans bullish.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch major producers' output guidance and China's export-control decisions.
outlooks.summary_zh: 大型生产商放缓钼产量增长,精矿市场偏紧,指向供应继续收紧。价格三个月已涨18%、12个月涨42%,部分已被计入,但消息面仍偏多。
drivers_zh: 铜钼巨头放缓钼产量增长
加工费创历史低位,供应链受战争冲击
中国出口管制期限与审查
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注主要生产商的产量指引及中国出口管制决定。

drivers: Zimbabwe keeps January 2027 lithium export ban
outlooks.summary: India's black mass ban and Zimbabwe's planned export ban are mildly bullish, but they affect recycled and secondary supply rather than major output. Price is down 13% in 3 months and the supply-pressure score is modest.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch the start of Zimbabwe's January 2027 export ban and its effect on concentrate flows.
outlooks.summary_zh: 印度禁止黑粉出口和津巴布韦计划的出口禁令略偏利多,但影响的是回收和二次供应,而非主要产量。价格三个月下跌13%,供应压力得分不高。
drivers_zh: 印度禁止黑粉出口
津巴布韦维持2027年1月锂出口禁令
中国延长出口管制暂停
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注津巴布韦2027年1月出口禁令的实施及其对精矿流向的影响。

drivers: Japan's yttrium supplies stalled under Chinese curbs
China extended suspension of export controls (bearish)
outlooks.summary: Yttrium supply to Japan has stalled and curbs on Japan remain a risk for specific elements. China's extension of the broader export-control suspension eases general risk, and prices are up 36% in 12 months.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch whether China's curbs on Japan ease and yttrium availability improves.
outlooks.summary_zh: 日本的钇供应已陷入停滞,对日限制仍是特定元素的风险。中国延长更广泛的出口管制暂停缓解了整体风险,价格12个月已上涨36%。
drivers_zh: 中国限制下日本钇供应停滞
中国对日稀土出口管制
中国延长出口管制暂停(利空)
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注中国对日限制是否放松及钇供应是否改善。

drivers: Congo conflict and Indonesia cuts squeeze supply
outlooks.summary: Congo conflict and Indonesian cuts are tightening supply, and the supply-pressure score is the highest in the group apart from molybdenum. Price is up 56% in a year but flat over 3 months, so further upside is still possible.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Indonesian export volumes and security in eastern Congo.
outlooks.summary_zh: 刚果冲突和印尼减产令供应趋紧,供应压力得分较高。价格12个月上涨56%,但三个月基本持平,仍有进一步上行可能。
drivers_zh: 刚果冲突和印尼减产挤压供应
加工费创历史低位,精矿偏紧
价格12个月上涨56%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注印尼出口量和刚果东部的安全局势。

outlooks.summary: Export-deadline news is mildly bullish, but China's extended suspension and new capacity such as the Thai stake offset it. Price is down 56% in a year and the score is weak.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch the antimony export deadline and any Chinese licensing changes.
outlooks.summary_zh: 出口期限临近的消息略偏利多,但中国延长暂停期限及泰国等新增产能抵消了影响。价格12个月下跌56%,得分偏弱。
drivers_zh: 锑出口期限临近
中国延长出口管制暂停
价格12个月下跌56%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注锑出口期限及中国许可政策的任何变化。

drivers: China export-control and dual-use review deadlines
Rising indium prices and tight by-product supply
outlooks.summary: Export-control risk and tight by-product supply are bullish, but prices have already jumped 67% in 3 months and China extended its suspension. Part of the shortage looks priced in, and the headlines are mostly general rather than specific.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch China's dual-use export licensing decisions and smelter by-product output.
outlooks.summary_zh: 出口管制风险和副产品供应偏紧偏利多,但价格三个月已大涨67%,且中国延长了暂停期限。部分短缺似乎已被计入,且新闻多为泛泛而谈。
drivers_zh: 中国出口管制及两用物项审查期限
铟价上涨,副产品供应偏紧
价格三个月上涨67%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注中国两用物项出口许可决定及冶炼副产品产量。

drivers: Saudi refinery attacks and Brent near $110
Prebaked anode above RMB 6,000 on feedstock rally
outlooks.summary: Gulf refinery disruption and high crude support feedstock tightness, and CPC is up 15% in 3 months. However, the supply-pressure score is weak and the newest news shows softer anode cost support.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Middle East refinery outages and anode-maker buying demand.
outlooks.summary_zh: 海湾炼厂中断和高油价支撑原料偏紧,煅烧焦三个月上涨15%。但供应压力得分偏弱,最新消息显示阳极成本支撑减弱。
drivers_zh: 沙特炼厂遇袭,布伦特油价接近110美元
原料上涨推动预焙阳极突破6000元/吨
阳极成本支撑减弱
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注中东炼厂停产情况及阳极厂的采购需求。

drivers: Middle East refinery attacks and high crude
Refinery outages in US and India
outlooks.summary: Refinery outages and Gulf attacks are bullish, but a coker restart, a weak score (+0.12) and a 5% fall over 3 months balance them. The net signal is unclear.
outlooks.watch_next: Watch Gulf refinery status and the pace of US coker restarts.
outlooks.summary_zh: 炼厂停产和海湾袭击偏利多,但焦化装置重启、得分偏弱(+0.12)以及三个月下跌5%相互抵消,整体信号不明确。
drivers_zh: 中东炼厂遇袭,油价高企
美国和印度炼厂停产
价格三个月下跌5%
outlooks.watch_next_zh: 关注海湾炼厂状况及美国焦化装置重启进度。
